name: Santa Barbara County Courthouse

dates.note: The Wikipedia infobox prints 'Built 1926'; the Library of Congress item for the building says it was 'Dedicated on August 14, 1929'; the style nodes carry 1929. All recorded, none changed. The building replaced a courthouse wrecked by the 1925 earthquake, so a start date of 1926 and a dedication of 1929 are not in conflict.

refs.title: NRHP reference No. 81000177; added to the National Register 23 January 1981; area 4.65 acres; architect William Mooser (as the Wikipedia infobox prints it)
Santa Barbara County Courthouse — National Historic Landmark nomination text (NPGallery)
refs.note: The nomination's own checklist line reads '_ Recorded by Historic American Buildings Survey: #' with the box unticked, which is the document saying there is no HABS record. It also quotes Mooser on the intention: the building was to be '.. .more Spanish than any hotel-de-ville in Spain.'

note: Seeded 5 Sep 2026. No survey block: the building's own National Historic Landmark nomination records that it was not documented by HABS, which is a stated absence rather than a search that came up empty. Two nodes name it at the same location string, so no alias was needed for the join; the street address is carried as an alias only because the nomination prints it.
